subject: Pricing bottleneck: ask for final approvals to lock forecast runway
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Anna Morales <anna@greenwave.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing bottleneck: ask for final approvals to lock forecast runway

Team / Anna —

Quick reminder on Greenwave (GW-2026-114). Ben and Anna have agreed to a 12-month commitment; the Sales PO has a requested 28% total concession (mix of seat discount + onboarding credit). Deal desk has held this while we validate margin and finance approval.

Ben: can you confirm the final commercial terms today so Deal Desk and Finance can provide an explicit approval or escalation? Finance needs a committed number by EOD Wednesday to include in the October forecast window; otherwise the revenue will pull to next quarter and materially shift our runway.

Actions requested:
- Ben: confirm the exact discount stack you want to present to the customer (breakout by line item) — reply here.
- Vanessa: if Deal Desk needs a formal memo, can you indicate whether a one-time credit + list-price reduction is acceptable or if this requires VP approval?
- Marcus/Karthik: if Finance signs off conditionally (e.g., pending 3rd-party reference), can we still include a committed amount in this month?

I've attached the customer's discount request and our approval matrix to speed triage.

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
Attach: discount_request_GW-114.pdf, approval_matrix_q4.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing bottleneck: ask for final approvals to lock forecast runway

Kimberly / Ben —

Thanks for the nudge. Quick read: Greenwave's ask is bigger than our standard discount band for their segment, so Deal Desk needs either (A) documented sign-off from Finance on the long-term margin impact, or (B) a VP waiver.

Per process: I can provisionally approve a 15% list discount + a $25k onboarding credit under authority; >15% needs Deal Desk review which typically takes 24 hours, and anything >25% needs VP approval. If Ben confirms he wants to present the 28% stack, I'll open a formal Deal Desk review now and tag Markus and leadership for a rapid decision.

If we get Finance to commit to recognizing $X in this period (even if contingent on a reference), Deal Desk can fast-track the paperwork and DocuSign flow. Otherwise the safe course is to mark the opportunity OPP-AT-RISK in the forecast and move to next quarter.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Deal Desk Manager
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing bottleneck: ask for final approvals to lock forecast runway

Kim / Vanessa / Finance —

Appreciate the detail. I discussed with Anna this morning; customer will accept a 15% baseline discount plus a $25k onboarding credit, but will push back if we don't offer a commercial concession to get the PO signed this month. My ask: can Finance confirm that we can book $360k ARR as committed if we recommend the 15% + $25k structure? That aligns to our quota/forecast and keeps Greenwave in Q4.

If Finance needs an extra assurance step (reference or payment milestone), I'm fine adding a 60-day milestone into the contract that doesn't push revenue recognition out — we can use that as an acceptance trigger.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing bottleneck: ask for final approvals to lock forecast runway

Ben / Team —

We can accept the 15% list discount + $25k onboarding credit and include $360k ARR as committed for the October close, subject to two conditions:
1) DocuSign executed within 10 business days (we need the signature window to prevent churn of intent).
2) Contract contains a 60-day milestone tied to initial data ingestion/acceptance (non-revenue-bearing for recognition purposes, used only as a project milestone).

If those are in place, Finance will sign off for the October runway. Vanessa: please proceed with the Deal Desk approval flow and tag VP Sales if any scope creep beyond 15% occurs. Marcus: please mirror this in the forecast sheet (line: GW-2026-114 — commit $360,000 ARR) and flag as "conditional-DocuSign" in column H so FP&A sees the caveat.

Kim: Ben, Anna — please confirm you will sign DocuSign today once Vanessa publishes the approved agreement.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
